words.definition: a glass device that produces light when connected to electricity
words.example: Facilities replaced the burnt-out light bulb in the hallway.
words.exampleTranslation: 設施部門更換了走廊裡燒壞的燈泡。

words.definition: a rule made by a company or organization to regulate its own affairs
words.example: The condo's by-laws require approval for any renovation.
words.exampleTranslation: 這棟公寓的內部規章規定任何整修都需要核准。

words.definition: to shout encouragement, support, or approval
words.example: The whole office cheered when the deal was announced.
words.exampleTranslation: 這筆交易宣布時，整間辦公室都歡呼了起來。

words.definition: a factor that makes a situation more difficult
words.example: An unexpected complication delayed the merger by several weeks.
words.exampleTranslation: 一個意外的複雜狀況讓這次合併延遲了好幾週。

words.definition: careful not to cause inconvenience or harm to others
words.example: Please be considerate of colleagues working nearby when on calls.
words.exampleTranslation: 講電話時請顧慮到附近工作的同事。

words.definition: the period of light between sunrise and sunset
words.example: The office switches to daytime lighting automatically.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室會自動切換成白天照明模式。

words.definition: an ornament used to make something look more attractive
words.example: Holiday decorations went up in the lobby this week.
words.exampleTranslation: 這週大廳掛上了節慶裝飾。

words.definition: to get rid of something no longer wanted or needed
words.example: Discard any expired samples from the storage fridge.
words.exampleTranslation: 請丟棄儲藏冰箱裡任何過期的樣品。

words.definition: in a way that is extreme and often sudden
words.example: Shipping costs have risen drastically this quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 這一季的運費大幅上漲。

words.definition: to remove or rub out something completely
words.example: Make sure to erase all data before returning the laptop.
words.exampleTranslation: 歸還筆電前請務必清除所有資料。

words.definition: a person who travels to discover unfamiliar places or things
words.example: The museum exhibit honors early explorers of the region.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場博物館展覽向這個地區的早期探險家致敬。

words.definition: concerned with or containing facts rather than opinions
words.example: Please keep the report strictly factual, without opinions.
words.exampleTranslation: 請讓這份報告完全根據事實，不摻雜個人意見。

words.definition: a piece of equipment or furniture that is fixed in position
words.example: The light fixtures in the conference room were recently upgraded.
words.exampleTranslation: 會議室裡的固定燈具最近剛升級過。

words.definition: shoes and boots collectively
words.example: Safety footwear is required on the factory floor.
words.exampleTranslation: 工廠廠區內規定要穿安全鞋。

words.definition: a category of art, music, or literature with a particular style or content
words.example: The bookstore organizes its shelves by genre.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間書店依照類型來分類書架。

words.definition: a room or building equipped for physical exercise
words.example: The company gymnasium is open to all employees after 6 p.m.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司的健身房在晚上六點後對所有員工開放。

words.definition: by this means or as a result of this statement (used in formal documents)
words.example: I hereby confirm my attendance at the annual conference.
words.exampleTranslation: 我在此確認出席年度大會。

words.definition: a pause before doing or saying something, due to uncertainty
words.example: She accepted the new role without hesitation.
words.exampleTranslation: 她毫不猶豫地接受了這個新職位。

words.definition: made at home rather than bought
words.example: The office potluck featured several homemade dishes.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室的百樂餐聚會有好幾道自製料理。

words.definition: friendly and generous treatment of guests or visitors
words.example: The client praised the team's hospitality during the visit.
words.exampleTranslation: 客戶稱讚了團隊在來訪期間的殷勤款待。
